summary: New Mountain Finance Corp filed an 8-K to disclose the pricing of a private offering of $150M aggregate principal amount of senior notes in three tranches: $40M 7.28% Series 2026A Tranche A due 2028, $35M 7.76% Series 2026A Tranche B due 2031, and $75M Series 2026A Floating Rate Tranche C due 2031. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The offering is exempt under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act and expected to close around June 18, 2026. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
